name: Hoshito Chiemi
source:
The student council president at the academy.

She is self-conscious about her childlike figure and flies into a rage whenever anyone points it out.

Contrary to her appearance, she has a serious and strict personality.

Although she doesn’t have much faith in Soraoka Yuuhi, she grants her permission to conduct her detective work.
